hub_tray.body: palm (dorsal shell, under a removable dorsal cover)
hub_tray.contents: carrier PCB 32 x 26 x 1.0 (on 4 x M2 bosses, 1.5 mm stand-off) with RP2040-Zero (23.5 x 18), 3.3 V LDO 300 mA, 7 x JST SH 4-pin (5 fingers + 2 palm-pad buses) and 1 x JST SH 6-pin (wrist)
hub_tray.keepout: strands pass under the floor (y < 8.5); window 24 x 20 in the floor

wiring.wire: 4 x 38 AWG PTFE-insulated stranded (7 x 0.04, OD ~0.30), colours: red 3V3, black GND, yellow SDA, blue SCL; PARALLEL, never pre-twisted, through every pin
wiring.bus: one I2C bus per finger at 400 kHz, daisy-chained through each board's 4 pads (in + out wire on the same pad)
order: knuckle board (abd chip + JST SH socket)

wiring.fatigue: see out/15/budget.txt: 38 AWG parallel bundle 0.05-0.17 % strain in every pin (limit 0.20 % for 1e6 cycles, assumed)
wiring.glue: glue points: a drop of flexible silicone adhesive (Sil-Poxy) or soft epoxy, not CA, so the wire is held without a hard edge
wiring.replaces_07: 07's axle slot box (x -3.6..-2.4, z -2.1..-1.0, at the max-stress fibre) is replaced by a Ø1.2 hole along +y at x +3.0 (neutral axis: I loss < 1 %)

connectors.finger: JST SH 1.0 mm 4-pin: socket on the knuckle board (palm), plug on the finger pigtail; swap = remove dorsal palm cover (2 x M2), unplug, pull 2 abd pins
connectors.thumb: JST SH 4-pin at the thumb mount (palm side of the CMC), same scheme
connectors.wrist: JST SH 6-pin at the hub; the forearm end is soldered to the ESP32-side RS-485/UART board (or a second 6-pin)
connectors.never: no connector inside a finger: every connector joint is a failure point and adds 3-4 mm

wrist_passage.chosen: through one hollow flex pin and one hollow dev pin of the wrist cardan (twist only); 6 x 38 AWG PTFE

pin.stress: bore 2.4 in Ø5: section modulus -5.6 %, 13's W13 numbers 139 -> 147 MPa (SCS), 315 -> 334 MPa (HLS)

wrist_passage.note: pin x/y positions are placeholders until report 13 fixes the new cardan (W13): keep the cable on the pin axes; never through the eye plate (centre cell (0,0) is free but a cable there kinks up to 58 deg)

confirmed_by_13.pin_material: cold-drawn precision tube 5 x 1.25 E355+C (or lathe-drilled 17-4PH); not a drilled hardened dowel
confirmed_by_13.stress: section modulus -5.3 %: SCS 145 MPa, HLS 326 MPa (SF >= 3.5 SCS, ~1.6-2.0 HLS)
confirmed_by_13.fatigue_38AWG_6_wires: flex 100 deg over 10 mm: 0.14 %; dev 50 deg over 9.4 mm: 0.04 % (limit 0.20 %)

notes: Non-magnetic parts near chips: DIP bar pins A/B in 316 or brass (not hardened ISO 8734), abd dorsal stub brass/316, keeper plugs PETG or brass. Hardened dowels near a chip must be >= 8 mm away (or be measured on the 08 R9 rig).
Chip variants per finger bus: A1 abd, B1 mcp_flex, C1 pip, D1 dip (fixed factory addresses, no reprogramming at boot).

Thumb: A1 cmc_rot, B1 cmc_flex, C1 mcp_flex, D1 ip; same joint module at each axis end opposite the wire exit; the thumb designer places them (keep >= 20 mm from the index MCP magnet, or calibrate with the index at its working angles).
Width: MCP stack ends at x 8.75 inside the 9.0 lug face (0 added); PIP 8.6 vs 8.05 (+0.55, taper region has >= 3 mm); DIP 8.35 vs 7.5 (+0.85). No sensor boss on the -x side of any finger.
